{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgM4znL98jMnqHja8i4ov","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XVGgBCw7rjqVSikfwb6LkY","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > cholesky/cholesky.cpp <<'EOF'\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// CUDA blocked (right-looking) Cholesky decomposition\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular.\n//\n// The matrix is padded on the device to a multiple of the tile size NB. The padding\n// region is set to the identity so the padded matrix stays positive definite and the\n// factorization of the original n x n block is unaffected (the padding rows/cols are\n// exactly zero off the diagonal and never contribute to the real block).\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                 \\\n    do {                                                                                 \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                      \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                      \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__, __LINE__,  \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__));                                          \\\n            exit(1);                                                                     \\\n        }                                                                                \\\n    } while (0)\n\nconstexpr int NB = 64;          // tile size (rows/cols per block)\nconstexpr int KC = 16;          // k-chunk for the tiled GEMM\nconstexpr int TILE_THREADS = 256;\nconstexpr int LDS = NB + 1;     // padded shared-memory leading dimension\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Tiled GEMM-NT kernel: C_tile (=|-=) X_rows * Y_rows^T, summing k over [k0, k1).\n// X, Y, C all row-major with leading dimension ld. Each block computes one NB x NB tile,\n// each thread a 4x4 micro-tile. The k loop runs in increasing order per thread.\n// If lowerOnly is set the 1-D grid enumerates only tiles with tileCol <= tileRow.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <bool SUBTRACT, bool LOWER_ONLY>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TILE_THREADS)\ngemm_nt_kernel(const double* __restrict__ X, const double* __restrict__ Y, double* __restrict__ C,\n               int ld, int k0, int k1, int rowBase, int colBase) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[NB][KC + 1];\n    __shared__ double Ys[NB][KC + 1];\n\n    int bi, bj;\n    if (LOWER_ONLY) {\n        // Triangular decode of the 1-D block index into (bi, bj) with bj <= bi\n        const int idx = blockIdx.x;\n        int r = (int)((sqrt(8.0 * (double)idx + 1.0) - 1.0) * 0.5);\n        while (r * (r + 1) / 2 > idx) --r;\n        while ((r + 1) * (r + 2) / 2 <= idx) ++r;\n        bi = r;\n        bj = idx - r * (r + 1) / 2;\n    } else {\n        bi = blockIdx.y;\n        bj = blockIdx.x;\n    }\n\n    const int row0 = rowBase + bi * NB;\n    const int col0 = colBase + bj * NB;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid & 15; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgM5PbLjY5tydehKUoHqz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Cholesky benchmark now runs on the GPU with CUDA, in the same two files, with the same executable name and no new dependencies beyond the CUDA runtime.\n\n**What changed**\n\n- `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` is now CUDA C++ (kept under its original name). The factorization is a blocked right-looking Cholesky with 64x64 tiles and three hand-written kernels per panel: a single-block diagonal-tile factorization, a triangular solve for the panel below it, and a shared-memory tiled double-precision GEMM for the trailing update that only enumerates lower-triangle tiles. The upper triangle is zeroed by a final kernel, as in the original.\n- The matrix is padded on the device to a multiple of 64 with an identity block, so any size works without bounds checks and the real block's result is unaffected.\n- The non-positive-definite check keeps the original semantics: the first failing diagonal index is recorded on the device and the same error message and failure return are produced.\n- Matrix generation keeps the sequential `rand_r` stream on the host and moves the O(n³) product B·Bᵀ to the GPU with the same per-element summation order. Validation computes L·Lᵀ and the max absolute and relative errors on the GPU.\n- `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt` enables the CUDA language, compiles the source as CUDA, targets the native GPU architecture, and keeps the optimization flags.\n\n**Verification** (RTX 3090, timing includes host-device transfers)\n\n| n | Original CPU | CUDA | Validation |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 512 | 28 ms | 3 ms | PASSED, rel err 9.7e-13 |\n| 2048 | – | ~20 ms | PASSED |\n| 4096 | – | 77 ms (297 GFLOPS) | PASSED |\n| 8192 | – | 422 ms (434 GFLOPS) | PASSED |\n\nThe reported sums for n=512 and n=2048 are identical to the original to 17 digits and the samples agree to about 1e-14.
